subject: Request: onboarding exception & evidence for BrightHalo pilot (no-PO)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@brighthalo.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Sato <elena.sato@brighthalo.com>
Date: 2027-11-02T09:12:00Z
Subject: Pilot onboarding — request for invoice-only (no PO) path

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team loved the throughput numbers. We're moving quickly on an internal pilot and wanted to check if Redwood could accept an invoice-only onboarding for the first 90 days (no PO) so we can align internal billing cycles.

We can provide the SOW and a SOC2 summary, and would be open to a short addendum for payment terms. Please let me know what evidence you need and the quickest way to get this over the finish line.

Best,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Platform Partnerships
BrightHalo

Attachments: SOW_BrightHalo_v1.pdf, BrightHalo-Company-Overview.pdf

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@brighthalo.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-02T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for invoice-only (no PO) path

Jordan —

Appreciate the note and the materials. Quick summary of what Procurement/Finance will need to evaluate an invoice-only (no-PO) path for a pilot:

- Signed SOW or statement of work (we have the PDF you attached)
- Proof of company identity (incorporation docs / BrightHalo overview — received)
- SOC2 or equivalent security attestation (summary received; full report may be requested)
- Point of contact for billing and a PO contact once pilot scales
- Maximum pilot commitment (dollars) so we can map to thresholds

I'll loop in Marissa from Ops and Sean from Procurement to map the exception ladder and estimated turnaround. If Procurement approves a temporary invoice-only lane, it typically requires a one-time exception sign-off and a known sunset date (we usually set 60–90 days).

Next steps: Marissa, can you confirm the evidence checklist and whether this meets the "short pilot" criteria? Sean, are there any immediate risks or mandatory redlines you foresee?

Thanks —
Avery
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-03T08:26:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for invoice-only (no PO) path

Looping in Naomi (credit & risk) separately but initial read:

- SOW looks good for a short pilot; value under $15k/mo — fits low-dollar exception band.
- SOC2 summary is fine for now; we should request the AICPA attestation PDF if available.
- Need statement of who will receive invoices + remit-to details (BrightHalo AP contact).
- We should require a sunset clause in the SOW (auto-reverts to PO if milestone exceeded).

I can prepare an "exception memo" for the Procurement Committee. For speed, propose: 60-day invoice-only approval, cap $40k total spend, review at day 45. If BrightHalo agrees, I'll route for committee sign-off (usually 24–48 hours).

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Onboarding Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOC2-summary.pdf (from BrightHalo)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-04T14:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for invoice-only (no PO) path

A quick credit check: BrightHalo is low risk for a short-term pilot. Conditions I'd require for an exception approval:

1) Maximum approved spend: $40,000 total during the pilot window.
2) Payment terms: Net 30 from invoice date.
3) Signed SOW with sunset clause (60 days) and clear owner for billing contact.
4) Procurement Committee memo with approvers (I will sign off alongside Marissa if the memo includes the above).

If we get those items, I'm comfortable green-lighting the exception for 60 days and will flag the account for review at day 45.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@brighthalo.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Elena Sato <elena.sato@brighthalo.com>
Date: 2027-11-08T16:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for invoice-only (no PO) path

Jordan / Elena —

Thanks for the quick responses and for sharing the SOW. Procurement/Finance have provisionally approved a temporary invoice-only onboarding for BrightHalo with these conditions:

- Pilot duration: 60 days from first invoice date
- Total pilot spend cap: $40,000
- Payment terms: Net 30
- Requirement: signed SOW with a sunset clause that explicitly states the PO-mandate will be re-instated after the pilot unless a separate PO process is agreed
- Evidence: final SOC2 attestation PDF to be uploaded to the shared drive (we already have the summary)

If that works, please:
1) Sign and return the attached SOW with the sunset clause
2) Confirm AP contact for invoicing (name, email, remit address)
3) Upload the SOC2 attestation to the Drive link below

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=brighthalo-onboarding-evidence
Procurement ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/POEX-112

Once we have the signed SOW and SOC2 PDF we'll route the committee memo and issue a formal exception letter.

Looking forward —
Avery
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
